name: Midjourney · image product
scope: Paid Midjourney web image creation, V8.2 and its documented Edit Model / Editor; excludes experimental Thinking Mode and video.
summary: Inventive image exploration with a precise foothold in masked editing and layered composition.
limitation: Unmasked regions can stay unchanged, but generated details and reference identities are not exact guarantees.

centerEvidence.claim: Illustrative prompt-to-image exploration: V8.2 emphasizes aesthetics and personalization, so new visual possibilities lead while humans select the direction.

sources.title: Midjourney Version
sources.finding: V8.2 is the default; its documentation emphasizes aesthetics, personalization and the current Edit Model.

sources.title: Midjourney Edit Model
sources.finding: V8.1/8.2 support instruction editing, four references, new compositions, perspective changes and retexturing; Raw reduces added styling.

sources.title: Midjourney Editor
sources.finding: Masks, layers, canvas transforms and iterative result panels are documented; only transparent areas regenerate in submitted layered edits.

N.claim: Masks, move/resize, layers and custom aspect ratios allow addressable decisions with visible results; generated content remains probabilistic.

NE.claim: Layer editing regenerates selected transparent regions while retaining visible supplied image areas, supporting iterative bounded production.

E.claim: The Editor explicitly retains visible pixels during layered edits; this scoped preservation is inspectable in exported images.

SE.claim: A masked edit returns four alternatives within a supplied image; selection remains human-led rather than an explicit critique process.

S.claim: Aesthetic personalization and iterative alternatives support discovering visual directions, but these sources do not establish strategic comparison or critique.

SW.claim: Reference recombination and restyling offer materially different visual possibilities; coherent strategy selection remains with the designer.

W.claim: Multi-reference composition, perspective changes and retexturing support substantial invention across image content, spatial arrangement and style.

NW.claim: Inpainting and outpainting invent content in user-selected areas with explicit instructions and iterative visual inspection.
